scripts.deploy: npm run build-client && cross-env NODE_ENV=production firebase deploy
scripts.install-all: npm install && concurrently "cd functions && npm install" "cd client && npm install"
scripts.setup-model: cd models/BlogTagPredictor && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.deploy-model: npm run setup-model && npm run train-model
scripts.train-model: cd models/BlogTagPredictor && python -c "from BlogTaggingModel import BlogTaggingModel; from training_data import training_data; model = BlogTaggingModel(); titles = [item['title'] for item in training_data]; contents = [item['content'] for item in training_data]; tags_list = [item['tags'] for item in training_data]; model.train(titles, contents, tags_list, epochs=25); model.save_model('blog_tagging_model'); print('Model trained and saved!')"
scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run start-model"
scripts.model-health: curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/health || echo 'Model server not running'
scripts.model-info: curl -X GET http://localhost:8000/training-info || echo 'Model server not running'
